method: Release compile_subscriptions example; wall time includes process launch, both file reads, parsing, compilation, JSON serialization, and output write. Memory sampled approximately every 5 ms; sampled peaks are lower bounds, not guaranteed OS peak measurements. No downloads or cache paging. Initial browser performance run overlapped some samples; results are approximate developer baselines.
limits: Parser and compiler are integrated; no independently instrumented parse-only or compile-only duration. Offline example shares the production compiler, but does not measure full native refresh peak memory. Cached sources differ slightly from the 12822-rule browser snapshot.
